### 2026

Africa's largest gathering of the Bitcoin & freedom-tech community.

### What is The Africa Bitcoin Conference ?

Every year, we bring together activists, innovators, and decision-makers to explore how Bitcoin safeguards fundamental freedoms, strengthens economic autonomy, and paves the way for lasting sovereignty.

### Let's amplify Africa's voice in the global Bitcoin story

Every year, the Africa Bitcoin Conference features dozens of inspiring speakers. Would you like to be part of this journey and share your insights and perspective on Bitcoin's role in shaping a more liberated Africa and world?

### ABC 26 Speakers

Each Year, Visionary Leaders Share Their Insights at the Africa Bitcoin Conference

### Host a Panel, Workshop or Side Event

As we prepare for a milestone edition of ABC 2026, we're inviting a select group of organizations and ecosystem leaders to host panels, workshops, or side events within the programme. This is an opportunity to leverage the ABC platform to lead high-value conversations and create meaningful experiences aligned with your work. Please note :

- Hosts are responsible for content, speakers, logistics, and execution
- ABC provides the platform, visibility, and programme integration

### Become a Sponsor of the Africa Bitcoin Conference

Be part of the flagship event shaping the future of Bitcoin in Africa! By sponsoring the Africa Bitcoin Conference, your organization positions itself at the forefront of innovation, education, and economic progress. This is a unique opportunity to connect your brand with thought leaders, visionary entrepreneurs, and a committed community working to transform the continent and the world through Bitcoin. ### About the event

The Bridge Between TradFi and Digital Assets. The Institutional Summit for Digital Assets. Paris, July 6-7, 2027.

### What it is

Signal Week is the summit for the institutional digital-assets sector, set in Paris. It succeeds seven years of Paris Blockchain Week as its elevation for the decade ahead: where Paris Blockchain Week built credibility as Europe's leading institutional digital asset conference, Signal Week positions it for the decade ahead.

### Audience

The organizer inherits an audience with more than 70% C-suite or investment decision-makers, 36,000-plus facilitated networking meetings, $50 trillion-plus in assets under management represented, and 389 government officials and policymakers. It is built for banking and financial services, asset management, enterprise, digital-asset native firms, traditional finance, infrastructure providers and family offices.

### Speakers

Past stages have hosted Changpeng Zhao (Binance), Jeremy Allaire (Circle), Lily Liu (Solana Foundation), Silvio Micali (Algorand), Charles Hoskinson, Joseph Lubin (ConsenSys), Tim Draper, Jan Van Eck (VanEck), Yoni Assia (eToro) and Arianna Simpson (a16z), alongside French ministers Anne Le Henanff, Clara Chappaz and Marina Ferrari. Featured faces for 2027 include Adam Back, Nikhil Sharma (BlackRock), Kara Kennedy (JP Morgan), Amy Oldenburg (Morgan Stanley), Ben Slavin (BNY), Christian Rau (Mastercard) and Daniel Seifert (Coinbase).

### Participation

Participants span digital-asset native builders, TradFi and fintech institutions deploying at scale, AI-for-finance providers and ecosystem partners. Founding partnerships for Signal Week 2027 are open.

### About the event

Team1 Korea and Tiger Research are hosting a Namsan hike as part of KBW 2026 side events, on September 26, 2026.

Join us for a guided hike led by the Tiger Research & Team1 Korea - they've climbed Namsan over 100 times and know every good viewpoint along the way.

### Event Info

Co-host: Team1 Korea (https://x.com/AvalancheKorea) x Tiger Research (https://tiger-research.com/)

Date & Time: September 26 Saturday 10AM

Location: National Theater of Korea (Google (https://maps.app.goo.gl/hobPFxXb13VmuVzn9), Naver (https://naver.me/Fqi65258))

### Itinerary

- 10:00-10:30 Reception & Registration
- 10:30-12:00 Guided Hike to Namsan Mountain
  - Enjoy iconic views of the Seoul skyline
  - Learning about the city's rich history
  - Reaching the summit
- 12:00-13:00 Descent & Cultural Stops
  - Visit the Observatory (Optional, tickets not included)
  - Descend the mountain
  - Explore nearby cultural spots with T1gers as your guide
- 13:00 Event concludes at the base of Namsan Park

### Hike Info

Difficulty: Moderate, suitable for most fitness levels.

Distance: Approx. 4km (2.5mi) round trip

Duration: ~3 hours, including breaks, sightseeing, and chats

### Please note

- Wear comfortable hiking shoes.
- Bring water, snacks, and sun protection.
- In case of inclement weather, the event may be postponed or canceled.

### About Tiger Research

Tiger Research is an independent research institution covering digital asset markets across Asia. Founded in 2022, Tiger Research has helped projects shape and distribute their narratives as one of Asia's most referenced sources of blockchain intelligence and institutional connectivity. Its reports, published in five languages, reach 100,000 monthly subscribers and more than 200 institutional clients, including banks, asset managers, and enterprises.

### About Tangem

Tangem builds the world's most user-friendly and secure hardware wallets designed as cards and rings. With EAL6+ certified chips, open-source code, and audited firmware, Tangem combines bank-grade security with everyday usability.

Self Custody in Your Pocket

No batteries, no wires, no seed phrases. Tangem wallets activate in less than 3 minutes, work with your smartphone, and keep your private keys offline at all times.

Built for Web3 Freedom

With Tangem, you can hold, swap, and manage your tokens, all without trusting a third party. You remain in full control of your assets anywhere in the world.

Simple. Secure. Tangem.

Whether you're new to crypto or a seasoned investor, Tangem makes self-custody accessible to everyone.

주머니 속 셀프 커스터디

Simple. Secure. Tangem.

### About the event

The Bridge Summit 2026, 서울에서 여러분을 초대합니다

이번 KBW, 9월 28일은 The Bridge Summit에서 함께하세요.

TV조선 × Bridge34가 공동 주최하고, 글로벌 Web3 벤처캐피털 Hack VC가 Main Partner로 함께하는 The Bridge Summit 2026이 오는 9월 28일, 조선 팰리스 서울에서 개최됩니다.

Bridge34

- Bridge34는 글로벌 Web3 프로젝트와 한국 시장을 연결하는 Web3 전문 액셀러레이터이자 마케팅 파트너로, 커뮤니티-미디어-파트너십을 기반으로 국내 Web3 생태계의 성장을 이끌고 있습니다.

TV조선

- TV조선은 대한민국의 주요 종합편성채널로, 폭넓은 미디어 영향력과 콘텐츠 역량을 바탕으로 Web3와 디지털 자산 산업의 대중화를 연결하는 미디어 기업입니다.

Hack VC

- Hack VC는 Web3 및 블록체인 기술에 집중하는 글로벌 벤처캐피털로, 초기 단계부터 유망한 프로젝트와 창업가에 투자하며 차세대 크립토 생태계의 성장을 지원하고 있습니다.

글로벌 Web3 프로젝트부터 기관, 투자자, 미디어, 그리고 한국 커뮤니티까지.

디지털 자산 - AI - 토큰화 금융의 다음 흐름을 만들어가는 플레이어들이 서울에 모입니다.

다양한 세션과 네트워킹, 프로젝트 부스는 물론, 이번 Summit에 참여하는 한국 커뮤니티를 위해 특별한 혜택도 준비되어 있습니다.

이번 The Bridge Summit은

현장을 직접 경험하고 참여하면서 다양한 리워드까지 받아갈 수 있는 컨퍼런스로 준비됩니다.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

### Hyperliquid Seminar Korea

An invite-only institutional seminar on Hyperliquid and onchain finance, during Korea Blockchain Week 2026

September 28, 2026

2:00PM - 5:30PM KST

Seoul, South Korea [Venue TBA]

Invitation Only | Limited to 150 Guests

### About

Hyperliquid Seminar Korea is an invitation-only seminar hosted by HypurrCorea × TENET during Korea Blockchain Week 2026.

Korea's financial institutions are approaching a moment of change. As the FSC develops guidance on digital asset allocation, banks, brokerages, asset managers and listed corporates are being asked to form a view on markets they have had little structured exposure to.

This seminar is built for that audience. Over an afternoon, we examine what Hyperliquid is, how onchain markets actually function, what stands between an institution and participation today, and where the next twelve months lead. The session assumes no prior crypto background and is delivered to the standard institutional diligence requires.

Builders, researchers and the Korean Hyperliquid community join the same room.

### Program (Tentative)

- Why Hyperliquid, Why Now - Structural change in onchain markets and the rise of Hyperliquid
- From Exchange to Financial Infrastructure - Architecture, market model and ecosystem expansion
- Institutional Access to Onchain Markets - Regulation, KYC and custody, through to how institutions can participate
- The Next Chapter of Hyperliquid - Direction ahead and the next stage of onchain finance
- Networking

### Who's Joining

A curated group of C-suite executives and senior leaders from Korean banks, securities firms, asset managers, listed corporates and family offices, alongside leading builders, researchers and participants from across the global Hyperliquid ecosystem.

### Hosted by

Host: HypurrCorea

Partner: TENET, Korea Blockchain Week by Factblock

Community Partner: Hyperliquid KR

Research Partner: Hyperliquid Research Collective

### Registration

This is an invitation-only event with limited capacity. Registration through Luma does not guarantee admission. Approved guests will receive a confirmation, along with venue details, prior to the event.

The seminar is held under the Chatham House Rule. Press and recording are not permitted.

### About the event

Hosted by ReboundX

Sponsored by Variational - Lighter - ASTER - Extended

(English Below)

전 세계를 휩쓴 E-Sports Trading의 오리지널 콘텐츠가 돌아옵니다.

전 세계에서 가장 바이럴된 Crypto Trading 이벤트의 원조.

Korea Blockchain Week의 밤, 서울에서 다시 펼쳐집니다.

단 하루, 세계 최고의 Perp DEX들이 한자리에 모입니다.

코드가 빗발처럼 쏟아지는 그 밤, 프로젝트 팀과 트레이더들이 직접 만나고 경쟁합니다.

PERP DEX DAY.

온체인 트레이딩의 최전선을 직접 확인하세요.

### Notice

- 본 이벤트는 승인 전용 행사이며, 정원은 600명 한정입니다. 신청자가 정원을 초과할 경우 ReboundX 터미널 (https://www.reboundx.net/en/terminal-exchange/BINANCE/spot/ETHUSDT)/ 리베이트 (https://www.reboundx.net/en) 사용 유저가 우선 선정됩니다.
- 식별을 위해 ReboundX 회원가입 이메일과 동일한 이메일로 Luma 신청 부탁드립니다.
- 행사 중 촬영된 사진-영상이 이벤트 홍보 및 SNS에 사용될 수 있음을 양해해 주시는 것으로 간주됩니다.

일시: 2026년 9월 28일 월요일

위치: 서울 강남 - 상세 주소는 승인자에게 개별 공개

### About ReboundX

크립토 시장은 늘 트레이딩으로 귀결되며, 트레이딩에는 항상 수수료가 발생합니다. ReboundX는 이러한 수수료를 단순한 비용이 아닌 새로운 기회로 바꾸기 위해, 주요 CEX와 Perp DEX를 아우르는 최고 수준의 리베이트 플랫폼으로 시작했습니다. 거래가 발생하는 즉시 리베이트가 계산되며, 24시간 이내 자동 정산됩니다. 현재 ReboundX는 리베이트 플랫폼을 넘어 트레이딩 터미널이자 DEX-CEX 애그리게이터로 진화하고 있습니다. 다양한 거래소를 하나의 인터페이스에서 연결하여, 트레이더들이 모든 거래에서 더 많은 가치를 돌려받을 수 있는 통합 트레이딩 허브를 구축하고 있습니다.

In crypto, trading is where profits are ultimately realized - and trading always comes with fees. ReboundX began as a highest-rate referral rebate platform across top CEXs and Perp DEXs, turning those fees from a cost into a new opportunity. Today, ReboundX is evolving beyond rebates into a trading terminal and a DEX-CEX aggregator - a single trading hub where traders get more back from every transaction.

### About Sponsors

2024년 전체 무기한 선물 시장의 약 2%에 불과했던 Perp DEX는 2025년 한 해 동안 거래량이 4.3배 성장하며, 사상 최초로 월간 거래량 $1T를 돌파했습니다.

2026년에는 CEX 거래량이 30% 이상 감소하는 상황에서도 성장을 이어가며, 전체 파생상품 시장의 10% 이상을 차지하는 구조적인 시장 축으로 자리잡았습니다. 최고점에서는 시장 점유율이 24%까지 치솟았습니다.

이는 단순한 일시적 트렌드를 넘어, 트레이더들이 중앙화거래소(CEX) 대신 Perp DEX를 선택하는 수요가 본격적으로 자리잡고 있음을 보여줍니다.

앞으로도 온체인 파생상품 시장의 구조적 성장이 이어질 것으로 예상되는 가운데, 글로벌 Perp DEX 시장을 선도하는 주요 프로젝트들이 PERP DEX DAY와 함께합니다.

Variational

2026년 글로벌 0티어 Perp DEX로 주목받고 있는 프로젝트. 크립토 헤지펀드를 DCG에 매각한 경험을 가진 파운더들이 설립한 RFQ 기반 Perp Engine으로, RWA를 포함한 다양한 자산을 온체인에서 거래할 수 있는 인프라를 구축하고 있습니다.

Total Raised: $61.8M

Backed by: Dragonfly, Bain Capital, Coinbase, Zoku Ventures 외 9개 글로벌 투자사

Lighter

18세에 하버드대학교를 졸업하고 수학 올림피아드 수상 및 Citadel을 포함한 글로벌 헤지펀드 경력을 가진 파운더가 설립한 Perp DEX. 블록체인 Perp 시장에서 Zero-Fee 모델을 선도적으로 구현했으며, Robinhood와 Founders Fund 등 글로벌 금융-투자사로부터 투자를 유치했습니다. 현재 Robinhood Chain의 온체인 ZK Perp Engine을 담당하고 있습니다.

Total Raised: $68M

Backed by: Ribbit Capital, Founders Fund, Robinhood, Haun Ventures

Aster

Aster는 YZi Labs의 지원을 받는 프라이버시 중심의 무기한 선물 거래소입니다. 사용자의 거래 활동을 보호하기 위해 Hidden Orders와 같은 기술을 제공하는 것이 특징입니다. 또한 암호화폐, 주식, 원자재에 대한 무기한 선물 계약뿐만 아니라 암호화폐 현물 거래도 지원합니다.

Aster의 기반에는 Aster Chain이 있으며, 이는DeFi의 미래를 구현하기 위해 설계된 Layer 1 블록체인입니다.

Total Raised: Undisclosed

Backed by: YZi Labs

Extended

유럽 대표 핀테크 기업 Revolut의 Crypto 출신 파운더들이 설립한 Perp DEX. 투명성과 강력한 매칭 엔진을 핵심으로, 마켓메이커와 트레이더 사이에서 보다 중립적이고 신뢰할 수 있는 거래 환경을 구축하고 있습니다.

Total Raised: $19M

Backed by: eToro, Jump Crypto 외 7개 글로벌 투자사

In 2024, Perp DEXs accounted for just 2% of the global perpetual futures market. In 2025, trading volume grew 4.3x, surpassing $1T in monthly volume for the first time.

In 2026, Perp DEXs have continued to grow even as CEX volumes declined by more than 30%, capturing over 10% of the overall derivatives market and establishing themselves as a structural pillar of the industry. At its peak, Perp DEX market share reached as high as 24%.

This growth signals more than a temporary trend. It reflects a growing preference among traders to choose Perp DEXs over centralized exchanges, pointing to strong long-term potential for the on-chain derivatives market.

And now, some of the leading Perp DEXs by global market share are coming together for PERP DEX DAY.

Variational

A globally recognized top-tier Perp DEX in 2026, founded by entrepreneurs who previously built and sold a crypto hedge fund to DCG. Variational is building an RFQ-based Perp Engine designed to bring a wide range of assets, including RWAs, on-chain.

Total Raised: $61.8M

Backed by: Dragonfly, Bain Capital, Coinbase, Zoku Ventures, and 9+ global investors

Lighter

Founded by a former Citadel and global hedge fund professional who graduated from Harvard at 18 and was a Math Olympiad medalist. Lighter pioneered the Zero-Fee model in blockchain perpetuals and has attracted backing from leading global financial and investment firms, including Robinhood and Founders Fund. Lighter is also powering the on-chain ZK Perp Engine for Robinhood Chain.

Total Raised: $68M

Aster

Aster is a privacy-first perpetual futures exchange where your positions, orders and trading activity stay hidden from other market participants.

Total Raised: Undisclosed

Backed by: YZi Labs

Extended

A Perp DEX founded by former crypto executives from Revolut, one of Europe's leading fintech companies. Built around transparency and a powerful matching engine, Extended aims to create a more neutral, trusted trading environment between market makers and traders.

Total Raised: $19M

Backed by: eToro, Jump Crypto, and 7+ global investors

### About the Event

AI is reshaping the way trading decisions are made. As AI agents begin to perform technical analysis, execute strategies, and place orders automatically, the role of human judgment is being redefined.

When automation tools become widely accessible, what will remain as the real edge for traders?

AI Meets the Chart brings together AI builders, quantitative researchers, and frontline traders to discuss how AI is being integrated into real trading workflows. The event will explore the practical application of AI quant trading, Agentic Trading frameworks, latency-sensitive execution, and the current boundaries of automated decision-making.

Through keynote sessions, panel discussions, and networking, participants will examine where AI can enhance trading performance, where human judgment still matters, and how traders should position themselves in the next phase of AI-driven markets.

To make the experience even more exciting, we've prepared a range of exciting prizes, including gift cards and gold. All participants will have the opportunity to win prizes through our event giveaways and lucky draws.

### Event Details / 행사 정보

- Date / 일시: Sep 29th - 30th, 2026 | 09:00 AM - 06:00 PM
- Location / 장소: AT Center, Seoul, South Korea (서울 aT센터)
- Official Website / 공식 웹사이트: www.gwdc.net (https://www.gwdc.net)

Join the Community / 공식 커뮤니티 참여

- GWDC 2026 Telegram Group: t.me/Web3LabsHK (https://t.me/Web3LabsHK)

### About Event / 행사 소개

Following the huge success of our inaugural event in Hong Kong this February, the 2nd Global Web3 Developer Conference 2026 (Global Web3 Dev Con) is officially landing in Seoul, expanding its scale to an unprecedented milestone!

Hosted by Web3Labs, GWDC is Asia's premier developer-focused Web3 summit. Taking place from September 29-30, 2026 (2 days) at the AT Center in Seoul, this mega-edition will champion the ethos of "For Builders, By Builders" on a much grander stage. This year, we are targeting 10,000+ Web3 enthusiasts, 200+ elite global developers, and 100+ tier-1 VCs for deep coding sessions, technical breakthroughs, and high-impact ecosystem exchange.

지난 2월 홍콩에서 성황리에 개최된 첫 대회에 이어, 제2회 글로벌 Web3 개발자 콘퍼런스 2026 (Global Web3 Dev Con)이 전례 없는 역대급 규모로 대한민국 서울에서 개최됩니다!

Web3Labs가 주최하는 GWDC는 아시아 최고의 개발자 중심 Web3 서밋입니다. 2026년 9월 29일부터 30일까지 이틀간 서울 aT센터에서 열리는 이번 대형 서밋은 "For Builders, By Builders(빌더를 위한, 빌더에 의한)"라는 핵심 이념을 더욱 거대한 무대에서 실현합니다. 올해 대회는 10,000명 이상의 Web3 애호가, 200명 이상의 글로벌 엘리트 개발자, 100개 이상의 탑티어 VC가 한자리에 모여 깊이 있는 코딩 세션, 기술적 돌파구 마련, 그리고 영향력 있는 생태계 교류를 펼칠 예정입니다.

Host : Web3Labs

### Event Highlights / 행사 하이라이트

- 10,000+ Mega Summit / 만인 규모의 글로벌 서밋: Connecting 10,000+ attendees worldwide, bringing together foundational layers, applications, and top-tier capitals under one roof. (전 세계 10,000명 이상의 참가자를 연결하고 하위 레이어 공공 체인, 상위 애플리케이션 및 최정상 자본을 한자리에 모으는 메가 서밋입니다.)
- Premier Hackathon / 프리미어 해커톤: 200+ global developers, 50+ breakthrough projects, real-chain tasks + top-tier mentor guidance + institutional VC judging. (200명 이상의 글로벌 개발자, 50개 이상의 혁신적 프로젝트가 참여하며, 퍼블릭 체인 실전 미션, 탑티어 멘토링 및 기관급 VC 심사가 함께 진행됩니다.)
- Global Innovation Exhibition / 글로벌 혁신 프로젝트 전시: 50+ Web3 innovative projects and direct VC matchmaking to accelerate global project launch, liquidity growth, and ecosystem building. (50개 이상의 혁신적인 Web3 프로젝트의 현장 노출 및 VC 직접 매칭을 통해 프로젝트의 글로벌 출시와 생태계 구축을 가속화합니다.)

### Speakers & Agenda / 연사 및 아젠다

Confirmed Speakers & VIP Guests / 참석 확정 연사 및 VIP 라인업

- (More featured speakers will be announced continuously / 추가 연사 라인업은 지속적으로 업데이트될 예정입니다)

### Agenda Focus Themes / 핵심 아젠다 하이라이트

- AI Agents & Autonomous Payments / AI 에이전트 및 온체인 자율 경제 Exploring how AI agents utilize stablecoins for automated micro-payments to power a frictionless decentralized economy. (AI 에이전트가 스테이블코인을 활용해 자율 미세 결제를 수행하며 마찰 없는 탈중앙화 경제를 촉진하는 방향을 모색합니다.)
- DePIN Commercialization / DePIN(탈중앙화 물리적 인프라 네트워크) 상용화 Driving real-world enterprise demand, revenue scaling, and sustainable token-burn mechanisms for hardware networks. (하드웨어 및 컴퓨팅 네트워크의 실제 기업 수요 창출, 매출 확장 및 지속 가능한 토큰 소각 메커니즘을 집중 조명합니다.)
- Tokenomics 2.0 / 토크노믹스 2.0 및 실질 수익 Shifting the paradigm from inflationary narratives to sustainable on-chain revenue models and fee-sharing mechanisms. (단순 내러티브와 인플레이션 덫에서 벗어나 온체인 바이백, 소각 및 수수료 분배를 통한 지속 가능한 실질 수익 모델에 주목합니다.)
- RWA & Institutional Capital / RWA(실물자산) 및 기관급 금융 Bringing traditional assets like T-bills and private credit on-chain to unlock deep liquidity and DeFi composability. (국채 및 사모 신용 등 실물자산을 토큰화하여 깊은 유동성을 확보하고 디파이(DeFi)와의 유기적 결합을 추진합니다.)
- Modular Infra & Restaking / 모듈러 인프라 및 리스테이킹 생태계 Advancing the frontiers of shared security, modular scalability, and seamless omnichain interoperability. (기술적 돌파구를 깊이 있게 다루며 모듈러 블록체인, 리스테이킹 및 옴니체인 상호운용성 네트워크의 공유 보안 진화를 탐구합니다.)
- Prediction Markets & Derivatives / 예측 시장 및 탈중앙화 파생상품 Analyzing the structural growth of on-chain prediction aggregators and next-generation crypto derivatives. (온체인 예측 시장의 기하급수적 성장 트렌드와 차세대 탈중앙화 무기한 선물(Perp DEX) 및 파생상품 도구의 진화를 분석합니다.)

### Event Overview

As foundation models become increasingly commoditized, the AI industry is entering a new era - one defined by agents, applications, and infrastructure. Open AGI Salon is a curated, invitation-style gathering bringing together builders, investors, researchers, and thought leaders at the intersection of AI and Robotics.

Co-organized by Sentient, Axis, and Kaito, this event is designed to spark meaningful cross-sector conversations and collaborations that go beyond passive attendance.

🇰🇷 Korean participants must apply via Rocketpunch (국내 참가자 전용 신청 페이지):

https://www.rocketpunch.com/event/EfCSDxQtQD

### Theme & Topics

The event explores the convergence of open-source AI and robotics - examining how autonomous agents, physical intelligence, and open infrastructure are reshaping industries and human-machine collaboration.

- The future of Open AGI and open ecosystems
- Agent-infrastructure and next-generation AI stacks
- Physical AI and the rise of intelligent robotics
- Scaffold design and its impact on agent performance and inference cost
- Building and scaling AI-native products
- Opportunities across the Asian AI and robotics ecosystem

### What Happens

2:00 PM | Doors open. Grab a drink. Meet the people building decentralized intelligence before anyone takes a stage.

3:00 - 4:00 PM | Introduction (Sentient, Kaito, Axis, Rocketpunch)

4:00 - 4:30 PM | Pannel Session 1

4:30 - 5:00 PM | Pannel Session 2

5:00 - 6:00 PM | Happy Hour

### About the Co-Hosts

Sentient Foundation

Sentient Foundation (https://sentient.foundation) is a non-profit organization dedicated to ensuring that Artificial General Intelligence (AGI) remains open-source and aligned with humanity. Guided by neutrality and transparency, Sentient promotes global adoption of open-source AGI, leads alignment and safety standards, provides grants to developers worldwide, and coordinates governance frameworks for responsible AI development.

Sentient Labs

Sentient Labs (https://sentient.xyz) is an AI research and product lab building AI systems capable of deep reasoning, continuous learning, and self-improvement. Its flagship product, EvoSkill, enables AI engineering teams to automatically evolve entire AI agents using only a model and a benchmark. Sentient Labs also runs AI engineering competitions on Sentient Arena, where top researchers compete to build the best harness-based agent solutions for the world's hardest AI reasoning problems.

Axis Robotics

Axis Robotics (https://axisrobotics.ai/) is building the Compounding Data Engine for Physical AI. We operate a large-scale distributed data network and a full-stack pipeline spanning simulation, egocentric data collection, pre-training, and real-time DAgger post-training. We have built a global distributed contributor community and a scalable data production infrastructure designed to continuously generate high-quality training data for Physical AI.

Backed by Hack VC, Nomad Capital, Pi Network, and other visionary investors, Axis Robotics bridges the data gap in Physical AI by delivering foundation model-ready datasets and sim-to-real pipelines that enable continuous, scalable policy improvement.

Kaito

Kaito (https://kaito.ai/) is the leading AI-powered intelligence platform, transforming how information is structured, shared, and valued across crypto, AI, stocks, and the wider frontier of tech and finance. Kaito powers a full stack of products, from its core intelligence platform (Kaito Pro, API & MCP) and creator marketplace (Kaito Studio) to its launchpad (Capital Launchpad), building new primitives for how influence and mindshare are measured, owned, and monetized.

### About Sponsors

Rocketpunch

Rocketpunch (https://www.rocketpunch.com/en) is a trusted business network built on verified identities.

Rocketpunch helps founders, investors, talent, and companies connect in a safer and more transparent way. Unlike open social networks where anyone can appear anonymously, Rocketpunch is designed around verified identities, enabling people and organizations to build trust and create real opportunities.

Rocketpunch is also evolving beyond a network for people and companies. It is becoming a platform where AI agents connected to real people and organizations can participate, act, and create opportunities. These agents can help users discover relevant people, jobs, investments, partnerships, and business opportunities within a trusted network.

### About Optimum

https://getoptimum.xyz/?utm_source=luma

Optimum is building the universal data acceleration network for blockchains - a high-throughput, low-latency networking protocol powered by Random Linear Network Coding (RLNC). We can integrate with any blockchain permissionlessly, delivering more efficient block propagation, by fixing data movement at the foundation. By redesigning how data is transmitted and accessed, Optimum transforms today's fragmented networking systems into a globally efficient coded network.

### About Google Cloud

https://cloud.google.com/

Google Cloud is powering the future of decentralized innovation and the autonomous agentic economy. By bridging enterprise-grade AI with resilient Web3 infrastructure, Google Cloud enables autonomous AI agents, fintech innovators, and institutions to securely execute real-time on-chain payments and programmable commerce.

Offering an end-to-end AI and Web3 stack - from custom TPUs and foundation models to high-performance blockchain node infrastructure, BigQuery on-chain data analytics, and enterprise key management - Google Cloud empowers builders to scale the next generation of agentic payment rails. Visionary Web3 projects and global enterprises across more than 200 countries and territories partner with Google Cloud as their trusted technology foundation.

### About Four Pillars

https://4pillars.io/en?utm_source=luma

Four Pillars is Asia's leading crypto research house, composed of sector-specialized researchers covering markets across Korea, Japan, Hong Kong, and Singapore. Four Pillars has published 600+ articles in both Korean and English, and hosted 20+ seminars and lectures - delivering actionable insights to builders, institutions, and policymakers while raising the industry standard. Four Pillars also operates an institutional-grade validator arm called : : Validated (FP Validated).

### About LINE NEXT

https://linenextcorp.com

LINE NEXT Inc., LY's web3 affiliate dedicated to developing and expanding the Web3 ecosystem, providing new digital experiences and leading Web3 innovation. Unifi is a dedicated stablecoin wallet accessible directly through LINE App provided by LINE NEXT. By supporting social logins via LINE, Apple, Google, and Naver, Unifi enables users worldwide - regardless of their blockchain experience - to manage digital assets with ease. Unifi aims to seamlessly integrate diverse stablecoin capabilities, encompassing payments, rewards, transfers, and interest features into a single ecosystem.

### About Auros

https://www.auros.global/?utm_source=luma

Auros is a leading global market-making and algorithmic trading firm, leveraging advanced liquidity solutions to stabilize markets and foster growth across the digital asset ecosystem. Beyond trading, Auros also offers a suite of tailored services to support token projects and crypto ecosystems throughout their lifecycle, including its distinctive Strategic Market Making service, DeFi and on-chain engineering solutions, bespoke OTC execution, and strategic investment support. We work closely with numerous crypto ecosystems, builders, exchanges, VCs, capital allocators, and institutional investors.

DIGITAL AF 하나됨 - Seoul '26

DIGITAL AF deliberately brings together communities that do not usually share the same room.

The program spans blockchain, AI, gaming and emerging technology alongside contemporary art, music and Korean culture.

ARC, Seoul

Sept 29 → Oct 3, 2026

By Wildcat × Digital AF

See you in Seoul.

하나의 공간. 5일간의 여정. 경계 없는 융합.

스폰서십 문의: digitalaf.xyz@gmail.com

## Crypto Compliance and Legal Roundtable, hosted by Solidus Labs and Yulchon

- Record: `kbw-official-crypto-compliance-and-legal-roundtable-09-29`
- Source: [kbw-luma-events.json](sources/kbw-luma-events.json)
- Starts: 2026-09-29T07:30:00.000Z
- Description: Source-backed
- Original page: <https://luma.com/fop77t0t>

### About the event

Crypto Compliance & Legal Roundtable | Seoul

Join us on September 29 during the Korea Blockchain Week in Seoul for an exclusive, invitation-only Crypto Compliance and Legal Roundtable, bringing together a selected group of compliance and legal leaders, regulators, and policy experts.

Hosted by Solidus Labs and Yulchon, this in-person session will focus on advancing global crypto compliance through practical discussion. The roundtable is designed to foster open dialogue, share best practices, and identify actionable solutions to today's most pressing regulatory and compliance challenges.

### Agenda

16:30 - Registration

17:00 - 18:30- Roundtable discussions: Best practices, challenges, and actionable solutions across key crypto compliance and legal topics, including:

- Tokenization and Implementation of the amended Capital Markets Act and Electronic Securities Act
  - How the recently enacted framework will be implemented in practice, including issuance, distribution and the treatment of investment contract securities.
    - Speaker: Ik Hyun Kim, Partner at Yulchon leading the blockchain and digital assets practice
- Cross-border VASP compliance -
  - Korea's planned extension of the Travel Rule to transfers below KRW 1 million
  - Growing regulatory focus on foreign and unregistered VASPs.
  - Stablecoins transfers and future challenges.
    - Speaker: Claire Lee, CEO of CODE
- Unfair Coin Trading Regulatory Frameworks in Korea
  - Overview of actual prosecution and referral cases over the past two years to examine the rankings of the most prevalent types of unfair trading practices and sheds light on the specific schemes and deceptive methods unique to the Korean virtual asset market
    - Speakers: Jackie Baek, Compliance Head of Korea at Crypto.com (https://Crypto.com)

18:30 - Networking

Address: Yulchon, Parnas Tower, 38F 521 Teheran-ro, Gangnam-gu Seoul Republic of Korea

Places are limited. Registration is subject to approval.

### About Yulchon

Yulchon is a full-service law firm headquartered in Seoul, Korea, advising on a full range of specialized practice areas, including corporate & finance, antitrust, tax, real estate & construction, dispute resolution, intellectual property & technology, and labor & employment. The firm was established in 1997 and has about 700 professionals. In addition to our main offices in Seoul, Yulchon has six overseas offices across five jurisdictions and 10 regional practice teams worldwide. The firm provides the highest quality of legal services to its clients around the globe, including their most complex legal matters.

Yulchon's Blockchain/Virtual Assets Team consists of seasoned experts who bring a wealth of experience and exceptional knowledge to deliver the highest standard of legal services in Korea's finance, blockchain, and virtual asset sectors.

### About Solidus Labs

Born in crypto and built for efficiency across all asset classes, Solidus Labs is the category-definer for agentic-based compliance in trade surveillance and risk monitoring. At its core is HALO, an AI-powered, risk-based platform trusted globally by financial institutions, crypto firms, and regulators to enable proactive, intelligence-led oversight across any product, venue, or asset class.

### About the event

Web3에서 자산을 잃는 순간은 코드가 깨질 때만이 아닙니다. 사용자가 "확인"을 누르는 순간에도 일어납니다. 악성 서명 한 번, 위장된 컨트랙트 하나로 지갑이 비워지는 사이 사용자에게 주어진 정보는 알아볼 수 없는 헥스 문자열뿐입니다.

TRUST404는 Blockchain 보안 아이디어를 실현해보는 해커톤입니다. 지갑-서명-트랜잭션, 분산 신원, 오프체인 의사결정 증명, 그리고 AI × Web3 보안 - 네 개의 기술 트랙 안에서, 참가자가 직접 문제를 정의하고 동작하는 프로덕트로 증명합니다.

모든 참가자는 Korea Blockchain Week 2026 기간 중 열리는 TRUST404 CONNECT에 초청되어 글로벌 프로젝트-재단 관계자와 직접 연결되며 수상팀과 우수 참가자는 발표를 통해 본인의 프로젝트에 대해 알릴 수 있습니다.

신청 링크 (https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSesp9fMznN1OXuYsZA5dODnnwhY4KN9tF9MEJci9irHR_4TOQ/viewform)

### 이벤트 정보

- 형식: 온라인 빌드 기간 + 오프라인 데모데이
- 온라인 빌드: 신청 후 ~ 9월 20일(일) 제출 마감

### 기술 트랙

[주최]

안암145_ANAM145

안암145는 고려대학교 정보보호대학원 연구진이 설립한 Web3 사이버보안 기업입니다. 커널 보안 기반 통합 지갑 '안암월렛(AnamWallet)'과 보안 단말기 '안암패드'를 중심으로, KYT 기반 이상거래 탐지와 DID 신원인증 등 Web3 디지털 금융 보안 인프라를 개발하고 있습니다. UNDP 글로벌 블록체인 혁신 프로그램에 선정되어 해외 공공 금융 인프라 실증을 수행하고 있으며, 중소벤처기업부 딥테크 TIPS 지원기업으로도 선정되었습니다. 공공-금융-산업 분야에서 안전한 Web3 보안 생태계를 만드는 것을 목표로 하고 있습니다.

- ANAM145 Homepage (https://anam145.io)

고려대 블록체인 밸리_Blockchain Valley

블록체인 밸리는 고려대학교 기반 블록체인 학회입니다. 2022년 3월 1기 출범을 시작으로 현재 50명의 학회원이 개발팀, 리서치팀, 보안팀, 코어팀으로 나뉘어 활동하고 있습니다. 프로덕트 제작, 리서치 페이퍼 발간, AML/CFT 리서치, 코어 리서치, 밸리데이터 운영을 중심으로 타 학회 연계 프로젝트, 기업 협력, 아이디어톤-해커톤 참여 등 활발한 활동을 이어가고 있습니다.

- Blockchain Valley X (https://x.com/blockchainkor?utm_source=luma)
- Blockchain Valley Instagram (https://www.instagram.com/blockchain__valley/?utm_source=luma)

[메인 파트너]

아이티센 피엔에스_ITCEN PNS

아이티센 피엔에스는 아이티센그룹의 보안 전문 기업으로, 양자내성암호(PQC), Web3 보안, AI 생체인증 등 첨단 보안 기술을 기반으로 고객의 디지털 혁신을 보호합니다. 2011년 설립 이후 클라우드-모바일-인프라 전반의 보안 컨설팅과 솔루션을 공급해 왔으며, PQC 기술을 적용한 보안 솔루션과 블록체인 지갑 솔루션을 선보이고 있습니다. 사명의 PNS는 플랫폼-보안-솔루션을 의미하며, 공공-금융 분야에서 축적한 그룹의 IT 서비스 역량을 바탕으로 안전한 디지털 금융 환경을 만들어가고 있습니다.

- ITCEN PNS Homepage (https://itcenpns.com/index.do)

Aomi Labs

Aomi Labs는 온체인 금융을 위한 Execution Harness를 개발하는 인프라 기업입니다. 사용자 요청을 트랜잭션으로 구성한 뒤 Live Chain State 기반 시뮬레이션과 정책 검증을 거쳐 사용자의 signer에게 전달하며, non-custodial-wallet-agnostic 런타임으로 온체인 프로토콜과 30개 이상의 오프체인 venue를 아우르는 공통 실행 레이어를 제공합니다.

- Aomi Labs Homepage (https://aomi.dev/)

[스폰서]

탄젬_Tangem

탄젬은 카드형-링형 콜드월렛으로 하드웨어 지갑의 새로운 기준을 제시하고 있는 글로벌 셀프 커스터디 지갑 기업입니다. 삼성 반도체와 협력해 개발한 EAL6+ 인증 보안 칩(Secure Element)에 개인키를 생성-저장해 키가 외부로 노출되지 않으며, 케이블이나 배터리 없이 NFC 탭 한 번으로 트랜잭션에 서명할 수 있습니다. 세계 최초의 링 형태 하드웨어 지갑 '탄젬 링(Tangem Ring)'을 비롯해 수천 종의 자산을 지원하는 지갑 제품군을 통해, 누구나 일상 속에서 안전하게 디지털 자산을 관리할 수 있는 경험을 만들어가고 있습니다.

- Tangem Homepage (https://tangem.com/ko/)

해시키_HashKey Chain

해시키 체인(HashKey Chain)은 홍콩 최대 규모의 제도권 암호화폐 거래소인 해시키(HashKey)가 개발한 컴플라이언스 친화적인 기관 수준 블록체인 인프라로, 글로벌 금융시장을 온체인 환경에서 새롭게 구축하는 것을 목표로 합니다. 컴플라이언스, 보안, 혁신을 핵심 가치로 하며, 스테이블코인, RWA, 기관용 DeFi가 유기적으로 연결되는 차세대 온체인 금융을 위한 기반 환경을 제공합니다.

해시키 체인은 거래소 서비스, 기관용 커스터디, 전통 금융기관과의 폭넓은 네트워크 등 해시키 그룹의 종합적인 디지털 자산 생태계를 활용할 수 있습니다.

또한 원활한 법정화폐 온-오프램프(Fiat On/Off-Ramp)를 지원하고, 규제를 준수하는 가상자산 서비스 네트워크와의 연결을 통해 기관의 온체인 금융시장 진입을 지원합니다.

- HSK Chain Homepage (https://www.hskchain.net/)

[네트워크 파트너]

써틱_CertiK

CertiK은 학술적 수준의 엄격한 기술 역량을 바탕으로 Web3 생태계가 직면한 다양한 보안 과제를 해결하는 글로벌 최대 Web3 보안 서비스 기업입니다. 블록체인 인프라 평가, 스마트 컨트랙트 보안 감사, 정형 검증(Formal Verification), 침투 테스트, 커스터디 아키텍처 검토, 시스템 성능 평가, 컴플라이언스 지원 등 디지털 자산의 전 생애주기를 아우르는 종합적인 리스크 관리 솔루션을 제공합니다.

현재까지 CertiK은 5,500개 이상의 기업 고객과 협력해 왔으며, 축적된 기술 전문성과 글로벌 경험을 바탕으로 여러 국가 및 지역의 디지털 자산 규제 체계 구축과 정책 발전에도 기여하고 있습니다.

- Certik Homepage (https://www.certik.com/)

람다256_Lambda256

람다256은 두나무의 블록체인 계열사로, 인프라-데이터-디지털 금융 전반에서 혁신을 이끄는 선도적인 웹3 기술 기업입니다. 금융기관, 글로벌 파트너, 대규모 웹3 애플리케이션을 지원한 검증된 경험을 바탕으로, 람다256은 엔터프라이즈급 블록체인 솔루션으로 디지털 전환의 미래를 계속해서 만들어가고 있습니다.

포필러스_Four Pillars

코인이지_CoinEasy

코인이지는 "크립토 쉽게 배우자"라는 슬로건 아래 Web3 교육과 커뮤니티를 아우르는 올인원 크립토 플랫폼입니다. 암호화폐를 처음 접하는 사람도 쉽게 이해할 수 있는 교육 콘텐츠와 시장 인사이트, 활발한 커뮤니티를 기반으로 Web2 사용자의 Web3 온보딩을 돕고 있으며, 글로벌 프로젝트의 한국 시장 진출을 지원하는 브릿지 역할도 수행하고 있습니다. 국내 Web3 대중화의 접점을 넓혀가는 대표적인 크립토 교육-커뮤니티 플랫폼입니다.

- CoinEasy Homepage (https://www.coineasy.xyz/)

베라체인_Berachain

베라체인은 '유동성 증명(Proof of Liquidity)'이라는 새로운 합의 메커니즘을 도입한 고성능 EVM 호환 레이어1 블록체인입니다. 자산을 잠가두는 기존 지분 증명(PoS) 방식과 달리, 유동성 공급 자체가 네트워크 보안에 기여하도록 설계해 밸리데이터-애플리케이션-사용자의 인센티브를 하나로 정렬합니다. 이를 통해 체인의 보안과 DeFi 생태계의 유동성이 함께 성장하는 구조를 만들며, 온체인 비즈니스의 성장 엔진 역할을 하는 것을 목표로 하고 있습니다.

- Berachain Homepage (https://www.berachain.com/)

디센트_D'CENT

디센트는 임베디드 보안 분야에서 10년 이상의 기술과 경험을 쌓은 보안 전문가들이 만든 블록체인 지갑 브랜드입니다. 2018년 세계 최초 지문인증 하드웨어 지갑을 출시한 이래, 전 세계 220여 개국의 사용자가 이용하는 글로벌 지갑 서비스로 성장했으며, 운영사 아이오트러스트를 통해 파트너사의 Web3 생태계 진출을 돕는 B2B 지갑 인프라 '위핀(WEPIN)'도 함께 서비스하고 있습니다. Secure Element와 신뢰실행환경(TEE) 기반의 보안 기술력을 바탕으로, 누구나 쉽고 안전하게 디지털 자산을 관리할 수 있는 Web3 인프라를 만들어가고 있습니다.

비앤비_BNB Chain

유닛티엑스_UnitTX

현재 ShortChall은 GIWA 위에서 Web3 서비스를 빌딩하고 있으며, 기존 Web2 사용자가 복잡한 진입 장벽 없이 자연스럽게 Web3 생태계로 연결될 수 있는 온보딩 구조를 만들어가고 있습니다.

디그리드_Dgrid

### TRUST404 - Web3 Security Hackathon

Trust Not Found. Build It.

In Web3, you don't only lose assets when code breaks. You lose them the moment a user clicks "Confirm." One malicious signature, one disguised contract, and a wallet is drained - while all the user ever saw was an unreadable hex string.

TRUST404 is a hackathon for turning blockchain security ideas into working products. Across four technical tracks - smart contract threat detection, decentralized identity, off-chain decision provenance, and autonomous exploit proving - participants define their own problem and prove it with a build that actually runs.

Every participant is invited to TRUST404 CONNECT, held during Korea Blockchain Week 2026, where you'll meet representatives from global projects and foundations face to face. Winning teams and standout participants get the stage to present their projects directly.

### Event Overview

- Format: Online build period + offline demo day
- Online build: From registration until Sunday, September 20 (submission deadline)
- Demo day: Tuesday, September 29, 2026, 5:30 PM - 10:00 PM
- Venue: Dreamplus Gangnam (311 Gangnam-daero, Seocho-gu, Seoul)
- Who should join: Web3 developers, security researchers, smart contract engineers, frontend/infra developers, and students in related fields
- Team size: 1-5 members
- Entry fee: Free
- Hosted by: ANAM145 - Blockchain Valley

### Schedule

- Submission deadline: Sunday, September 20
- What to submit: Repository - Demo - Presentation
- Demo Day & Awards: Tuesday, September 29, 2026 - live demos, Q&A, judging, and awards
- TRUST404 CONNECT: During KBW 2026 - winning teams invited, foundation networking

Demo Day Timetable

17:30 - 18:00 Doors open - Check-in

18:00 - 18:30 Opening remarks - Introduction of host organizations

18:30 - 19:30 Sponsor introductions - Lucky draw

19:30 - 21:00 Winning team presentations (15 min per team) - Judge feedback

21:00 - 22:00 Awards - Networking

### Technical Tracks

Pick a track, then define your own problem and approach within it. The expected outcomes below are examples - feel free to go beyond them.

1. Smart Contract Threat Detection
2. Decentralized Identity - DID & VC
3. Off-chain Decision Provenance
4. Autonomous Exploit Prover

For detailed track descriptions, check the hackathon website (https://trust404.co.kr/ ) and Discord (https://discord.com/invite/4WgxmmSba).

Hackathon Homepage: https://trust404.co.kr/

Discord invite: https://discord.com/invite/4WgxmmSba

Open Track

Examples: x402, agent payments, multichain

For the Open Track, you can build on the example ideas above - or bring any other Web3 security or application idea of your own.

### Judging Criteria

- Problem definition - 25% - Is it clear who faces this problem? Is it a real one?
- Security soundness - 25% - Is the threat model well-defined? Have you considered how it could be bypassed?
- Working implementation - 20% - Can it be demonstrated live?
- Verifiability - 15% - Have you proven the impact with numbers or scenarios?
- Scalability - 5% - Can this live on after the hackathon?
- Judge's discretionary points - 10%

We value working demos over slides. Please include a live demonstration in your presentation.

### Prizes

- 1st place: ₩2,000,000
- 2nd place: ₩1,000,000
- 3rd place: ₩500,000
- Special Award: ₩500,000

All winning teams will have the opportunity to discuss follow-up collaboration with ANAM145 and partner foundations.

### Participant Support

- Dedicated Discord channel with technical Q&A
- Meals and drinks provided on demo day
- English support available throughout the event

### How to Apply

Participation is by application. When applying, please prepare:

- Your track of interest
- For team applications: names and email addresses of all team members

### Judges & Partners

- Prof. Junghee Lee, Korea University
- CEO of ANAM145
- Host: ANAM145 - Blockchain Valley
- Main partner: ITCEN PNS - Aomi Labs
- Sponsors: Tangem - HashKey Chain
- Networking partners: CertiK - Lambda256 - Zeta - Four Pillars - CoinEasy - Berachain - D'CENT - Quack AI - BNB Chain - Unibase - UnitTX - ShortChall - Dgrid AI - Radius - DigitalAsset - GWDC - Blockmedia - Exilist
- Academy partners: De-Butler - CURG - Gairos - BlueNode - Skkrypto - BAY - Aidenteti - pdao - Decipher - Ewha-Chain - HYBLOCK - Orakle - blockblock - Layer-A

### Hosts

ANAM145

ANAM145 is a Web3 cybersecurity company founded by researchers from the Korea University Graduate School of Information Security. Built around AnamWallet, a kernel-security-based integrated wallet, and AnamPad, a secure terminal device, the company develops digital finance security infrastructure for Web3 - including KYT-based anomalous transaction detection and DID identity verification. ANAM145 was selected for the UNDP Global Blockchain Innovation Program, where it is running public financial infrastructure pilots overseas, and is also a Deep Tech TIPS company backed by Korea's Ministry of SMEs and Startups.

Its mission is to build a safe Web3 security ecosystem across the public, financial, and industrial sectors.

Blockchain Valley (Korea University)

Blockchain Valley is a blockchain society based at Korea University. Since its first cohort launched in March 2022, it has grown to 50 members working across four teams: Development, Research, Security, and Core. Its activities span product building, research paper publication, AML/CFT research, core protocol research, and validator operations - alongside joint projects with other societies, corporate partnerships, and participation in ideathons and hackathons.

### Main Partner

ITCEN PNS

ITCEN PNS is the security specialist of the ITCEN Group, protecting its clients' digital innovation with advanced security technologies including post-quantum cryptography (PQC), Web3 security, and AI-powered biometric authentication. Founded in 2011, the company has delivered security consulting and solutions across cloud, mobile, and infrastructure, and now offers PQC-based security solutions and blockchain wallet solutions. Its name stands for Platform, Security, and Solution - and drawing on the group's IT service expertise in the public and financial sectors, ITCEN PNS is building a safe digital finance environment.

Aomi Labs

Aomi Labs is an infrastructure company developing an Execution Harness for on-chain finance. It composes transactions based on user requests, runs simulations against live chain state, and performs policy verification before passing them to the user's signer. Operating as a non-custodial, wallet-agnostic runtime, Aomi Labs provides a unified execution layer that bridges on-chain protocols and over 30 off-chain venues.

### Sponsors

Tangem

Tangem is a global self-custody wallet company redefining hardware wallets with its card- and ring-type cold wallets. Private keys are generated and stored on an EAL6+ certified secure element chip developed with Samsung Semiconductors - never leaving the device - and transactions are signed with a single NFC tap, no cables or batteries required. From the Tangem Ring, the world's first ring-shaped hardware wallet, to a wallet lineup supporting thousands of assets, Tangem is making secure digital asset management part of everyday life.

HashKey Chain

HashKey Chain is a compliance-friendly, institutional-grade blockchain infrastructure developed by HashKey, Hong Kong's largest licensed cryptocurrency exchange, with the goal of rebuilding global financial markets in an on-chain environment. With compliance, security, and innovation as its core values, it provides the foundation for next-generation on-chain finance where stablecoins, RWA, and institutional DeFi are organically connected.

HashKey Chain draws on the HashKey Group's comprehensive digital asset ecosystem, including exchange services, institutional custody, and an extensive network of traditional financial institutions. It also supports seamless fiat on/off-ramps and helps institutions enter the on-chain financial market through connections with regulation-compliant virtual asset service networks.

### Networking Partners

CertiK

CertiK is the world's largest Web3 security services company, tackling the full range of security challenges facing the Web3 ecosystem with academically rigorous technical expertise. Its comprehensive risk management solutions span the entire lifecycle of digital assets - including blockchain infrastructure assessment, smart contract security audits, formal verification, penetration testing, custody architecture review, system performance evaluation, and compliance support.

To date, CertiK has worked with more than 5,500 enterprise clients, and drawing on its accumulated technical expertise and global experience, it also contributes to the development of digital asset regulatory frameworks and policy across multiple countries and regions.

Lambda256

Lambda256, the blockchain arm of Dunamu, is a leading Web3 technology company driving innovation across infrastructure, data, and digital finance. With a proven track record supporting financial institutions, global partners, and large-scale Web3 applications, Lambda256 continues to shape the future of digital transformation with enterprise-grade blockchain solutions.

Zeta

ZetaChain is building this application layer for private AI, starting with Anuma. Anuma is a multi-model AI app where a single memory can be used across multiple AI models, and ownership of that memory remains with the user - currently used by over 300,000 people.

Four Pillars

Four Pillars is a research-driven Web3 solutions company bridging the gaps between Asia and the world, traditional and on-chain finance, and research and execution. Rather than stopping at reading information, Four Pillars covers the full journey - understanding, participating, and building - under one consistent standard.

CoinEasy

CoinEasy is an all-in-one crypto platform for Web3 education and community, built around the motto "Learn crypto the easy way." With accessible educational content, market insights, and an active community, CoinEasy helps Web2 users onboard smoothly into Web3 - while also serving as a bridge for global projects entering the Korean market. It has grown into one of Korea's leading platforms for bringing Web3 to a wider audience.

Berachain

Berachain is a high-performance, EVM-compatible Layer 1 blockchain built on Proof of Liquidity - a novel consensus mechanism that aligns the incentives of validators, applications, and users. Unlike traditional Proof of Stake, where assets sit locked away, Berachain ties network security to active liquidity provision, so the chain's security and its DeFi ecosystem grow together. The result is a blockchain designed to serve as a growth engine for on-chain businesses.

D'CENT

D'CENT is a blockchain wallet brand built by security experts with over a decade of experience in embedded security. Since launching the world's first biometric hardware wallet in 2018, D'CENT has grown into a global wallet service used across 220 countries. Its operator, IoTrust, also runs WEPIN, a B2B wallet infrastructure that helps partners enter the Web3 ecosystem quickly and easily. Built on Secure Element and Trusted Execution Environment (TEE) technology, D'CENT is creating Web3 infrastructure that makes managing digital assets safe and simple for everyone.

Quack AI

Quack AI is a unified execution and governance layer for AI agents, bundling proposal analysis, delegation, policy verification, and on-chain execution into a single stack - connecting DAO operations, agent-to-agent payments, treasury automation, and tokenized asset governance through one shared policy and execution pipeline.

BNB Chain

BNB Chain is one of the world's largest and most active blockchain ecosystems, supported by a global community of developers and users. With high throughput, low transaction costs, and full EVM compatibility, BNB Chain powers scalable applications across finance, gaming, and the broader Web3 economy.

Unibase

Unibase is a decentralized memory layer for AI agents. It aims to build the infrastructure that lets agents retain memory beyond a single session, collaborate with agents on other platforms, and evolve on their own.

UnitTX

Unit TX is a marketing studio focused on bringing global Web3 projects into the Korean market. For Unit TX, marketing is not about making things known - it's about making them understood. When a project crosses borders, what must travel with it is context: Unit TX reads the market through on-chain data, builds relationships through community, and translates a project's language into Korea's language through research and media.

ShortChall

ShortChall is a global participatory platform combining short-form content, challenges, rewards, and commerce. Beyond letting users create short-form content and take part in challenges and voting, it is building an ecosystem that extends into live commerce and content-driven commerce. ShortChall is currently building its Web3 services on GIWA, creating an onboarding structure that connects existing Web2 users into the Web3 ecosystem without complex entry barriers.

Dgrid AI

DGrid AI builds an open, transparent, community-driven decentralized AI network, giving developers and users low-cost, verifiable, trust-minimized access to a wide range of AI models and agents through an integrated smart marketplace and scheduling layer. With early traction including over $23M in revenue, 50K DAU / 500K MAU, and 15K+ subscribers, alongside research achievements such as PoQ and Optimistic TEE-Rollups, DGrid AI aims to build sustainable decentralized AI infrastructure.

Radius

Radius builds economic infrastructure for rollups and arbitrageurs, centered on open and shared value creation. Radius's Secure Block Building (SBB) and Lighthouse help rollups capture revenue efficiently and enable arbitrageurs to compete in blockspace auctions spanning CEXs, DEXs, and Ethereum's L1 and L2s.

DigitalAsset

DigitalAsset is a blockchain and virtual asset media outlet founded in October 2022, aiming to reduce information asymmetry in the fast-moving digital asset market by providing verified news, data, and research. Alongside timely coverage of price, regulation, and technology, it interprets on-chain metrics, charts, and macroeconomic trends, and provides the grounds for decision-making - from beginners to institutional and professional investors - through in-depth reports on projects, companies, and people (D'Asset Research), on-site coverage of seminars and forums (D'Asset On&Off), and VC investment trend analysis.

GWDC

GWDC (Global Web3 Dev Con) is a global Web3 developer conference connecting developers, companies, and investors. Hosted by Web3Labs and co-hosted by Techub News and others, its slogan is "For Builders, By Builders." Running a main conference and hackathon side by side, GWDC tackles real implementation challenges across AI×Web3, RWA, PayFi, account abstraction, and on-chain infrastructure.

Blockmedia

Blockmedia is one of Korea's leading Web3 media outlets, delivering content on digital assets and blockchain. Alongside a wide range of market information, it strives to provide readers with forward-looking insight from diverse perspectives spanning regulation, finance, economics, and technology.

Exilist

Exilist is a GTM partner supporting global projects' entry and growth in the Korean market, with a focus on on-chain finance and blockchain infrastructure. Drawing on its own research and local operating experience, it designs positioning and execution strategies, and drives user engagement and product adoption through Korean-language content, community, KOL campaigns, and media outreach. A senior team with exchange business development and global GTM/media experience leads everything from strategy to execution, having worked with over 50 global teams to date. Tokenized securities are currently its main research and business focus.

### Academy Partners

HYBLOCK (Hanyang University)

HYBLOCK brings together people who see blockchain as a transformative technology and want to become pioneers of its future. Aiming to grow professional talent for the blockchain industry, members work in either the business team or the development team based on the skills they want to build. HYBLOCK centers its activities on research into the blockchain industry and ecosystem, and runs the Telegram channel "Allround X HYBLOCK" to share insights with newcomers.

De-Butler (Kwangwoon University)

De-Butler is a community founded to make Web3 accessible to everyone. Beyond simply training more builders, De-Butler aims to help anyone interested in Web3 find a natural way into the ecosystem.

Aidenteti Crew

Founded in 2022, Aidenteti Crew is a Web3 offline academic and community group for current and aspiring builders. It aims to be a "builders' playground" - an open, flexible space where members freely pursue project development, hackathons, recruiting, and community activities.

SKKRYPTO (Sungkyunkwan University)

SKKRYPTO is the official blockchain society of Sungkyunkwan University, founded in 2018. With around 110 members since its founding, it brings together students from diverse majors to lower the barriers to blockchain technology and serves as a collaborative network that expands insight by combining broad perspectives.

Blue Node (Inha University)

Blue Node is a blockchain society founded at Inha University in 2023, with around 60 members based in Incheon. Going beyond study alone, Blue Node explores the fundamentals of blockchain technology and aims to make real contributions to the blockchain ecosystem.

CURG (Inter-university Society)

CURG is a blockchain alliance society founded in 2018 by universities across Seoul. A gathering of tech enthusiasts, CURG conducts blockchain research and proof-of-concept projects with a 3T mindset - Trendy, Thoughtful, Transdisciplinary - with the goal of accelerating blockchain adoption and contributing to ecosystem growth.

Gairos (Gachon University)

Gairos, the blockchain society of Gachon University, pursues innovative applications of blockchain and broader public access to the technology. It explores ways to understand blockchain's strengths deeply, spread them widely, and apply them in the real world - growing from the top society in Gyeonggi Province toward the global stage through active collaboration with industry and university players at home and abroad.

BAY (Yonsei University)

Blockchain at Yonsei (BAY), founded in 2017 as Korea's first blockchain society, aims to spread blockchain innovation and contribute to ecosystem growth. Across Web3, DeFi, NFTs, and blockchain infrastructure, members build deep technical understanding and hands-on experience through weekly sessions with industry experts, team-based development projects, hackathons, and research.

PDAO (POSTECH)

PDAO is a crypto and blockchain community based at POSTECH (Pohang University of Science and Technology). Open to anyone, PDAO serves as a space where people interested in the blockchain ecosystem can plan and join activities that let them freely contribute to the industry.

Decipher (Seoul National University)

Decipher, the blockchain society of Seoul National University, was founded in late 2017 with the mission of contributing to the healthy growth of the blockchain industry through technology development and value research. Through seminars, lectures, conferences, industry-academia research, and open-source contributions, Decipher works to build a healthy blockchain ecosystem. Having produced outstanding talent for both industry and academia, it has established itself as Korea's leading blockchain society - and aims to become an irreplaceable one worldwide.

Ewha-Chain (Ewha Womans University)

Ewha-Chain is a leading university blockchain community in Korea, connected with Google Cloud, Solana, BNB Chain, NEAR, Samsung Securities, Bithumb, KPMG, PwC, and more. Specializing in Web3 conferences, hackathons, and meetups, Ewha-Chain welcomes partnerships and ecosystem collaboration.

Orakle (KAIST)

Orakle is a Web3 builder community at KAIST united by the vision of "completing the mass adoption of blockchain." Each cohort spends a semester moving between research and building, proving itself through results. Orakle offers deep understanding to those new to blockchain - and a stage to shine for those who already know it.

blockblock (Yonsei University)

blockblock is a blockchain club at Yonsei University, founded in September 2022 as a gathering place for anyone who wants to study blockchain together. It strives to be an ecosystem where people interested in blockchain can grow and make a positive impact on the Web3 industry - run, true to the spirit of blockchain, by members from diverse departments bringing diverse perspectives.

Layer-A (Ajou University)

Layer-A is Ajou University's blockchain community, researching ways to contribute to the growth of the Web3 ecosystem - and opening doors for anyone who wants to take part in the blockchain and Web3 industry.

### About the event

AI-알고리즘 트레이딩, 가상자산 세무에 대한 인사이트를 각 분야의 전문가들과 함께 살펴봅니다.

이번 행사는 전문가의 인사이트 공유와 자유로운 대화, 네트워킹에 집중하는 자리로 구성됩니다.

일시: 9월 29일, 오후 6:30-10:30

장소: 서울 언주역 인근

참석 인원: 20명 한정

### 각 세션에서 다루는 내용

AI & Algorithmic Trading

AI Crypto Trading Competition 우승팀이 직접 참여하여 AI 및 알고리즘 기반 트레이딩에 대한 관점과 실제 시장에서의 활용 방식에 대해 이야기합니다.

- AI 기반 트레이딩에 대한 접근 방식
- 알고리즘 트레이딩이 활용되는 시장의 기회
- 실제 운용 과정에서 얻은 인사이트
- 시장 변동성과 리스크에 대응하는 방식

Crypto Tax

세무 전문가와 함께 국내 가상자산 투자자가 알아야 할 가상자산 세무 및 과세 관련 주요 사항을 살펴봅니다.

실제 투자 및 자산 관리 과정에서 참고할 수 있는 실무적인 내용 중심으로 진행됩니다.

Bybit Earn

- Staking, Earn 서비스 활용한 예치 자산 활용법

### Who This Is For

- Asset VIP 고객 및 적극적으로 가상자산 시장을 탐색하는 투자자
- AI-알고리즘 트레이딩 및 새로운 트레이딩 전략에 관심 있는 분
- 가상자산 투자 및 자산 관리와 관련된 세무 정보를 확인하고 싶은 분
- 트레이딩 및 디지털 자산 시장의 다양한 참여자들과 네트워킹하고 싶은 분

좌석이 제한된 프라이빗 행사인 만큼, 실질적인 정보 교류와 네트워킹을 목적으로 하는 참석자 중심으로 운영됩니다.

### Please Note

본 행사는 초청 기반의 프라이빗 이벤트이며, 좌석은 20명으로 제한됩니다.

모든 참가 신청은 확인 및 승인 절차를 거쳐 최종 확정됩니다.

각 세션은 시장 및 트레이딩에 대한 정보와 인사이트 공유를 목적으로 합니다.

행사에서 공유되는 내용은 정보 제공을 위한 것이며, 개별 투자자의 투자 판단에 대한 책임을 대신하지 않습니다.

행사 진행을 위해 사진 및 영상 촬영이 일부 진행될 수 있습니다.

### 🇬🇧 Liquidity Evening by Turtle

Kick off KBW the right way.

The night before the conference opens, join us on a rooftop in the heart of Gangnam for an evening built for the people actually moving liquidity.

Two short keynotes and one panel on where LPs are actually deploying in Korea. The rest of the night is drinks and conversation with the funds, family offices, and builders shaping liquidity in this market. Rooftop in Gangnam, drinks, Seoul skyline.

Date: Tuesday, 29 September 2026

Time: 6:30 PM to 10:00 PM

Venue: L7 Gangnam Floating Bar, Gangnam, Seoul

Language: English, with bilingual hosting

Hosted by: Turtle (https://x.com/turtledotxyz) and Lunar Strategy (https://x.com/LunarStrategy)

Co-hosts: Bond (https://x.com/BondSuperApp_) and 0G Labs (https://x.com/0G_labs)

Premium sponsor: Credi (https://x.com/credilabs)

### Speakers

Essi Lagevardi (https://x.com/SuperChad15), CEO and Founder of Turtle (https://x.com/turtledotxyz) - building one of crypto's largest liquidity coordination networks.

Taweh Beysolow II (https://x.com/TawehBeysolow), CEO and Co-founder of Bond (https://x.com/BondSuperApp_) - ex-Jump Trading and Flowdesk quant, now building the first DeFi super app for the agentic economy.

Michael Heinrich (https://x.com/michaelh_0g), CEO and Co-founder of 0G Labs (https://x.com/0G_labs) - leading the largest AI L1 ecosystem with $325M+ raised; Forbes 40 under 40, ex-Bridgewater and Microsoft.

Alessio Marinelli (https://www.linkedin.com/in/marinellialessio/), CEO of Credi (https://x.com/credilabs) - tokenizing private credit and SME receivables, bringing real-world yield on-chain since 2017.

Tim Haldorsson (https://x.com/TimHaldorsson), Founder of Lunar Strategy (https://x.com/LunarStrategy) and CMO at Turtle - panel moderator. In crypto since 2017, helping 400+ projects scale.

### Who this is for

LPs, family offices, and funds allocating in APAC. Builders and protocols working on liquidity infrastructure. If you move capital or build where it flows, this evening is for you.

### The agenda

- 6:30 PM - Doors open, drinks and catering
- 7:30 PM - Opening keynote: Essi Lagevardi, CEO of Turtle
- 7:45 PM - Partner keynote: Taweh Beysolow II, CEO of Bond
- 8:00 PM - Partner keynote: Michael Heinrich, CEO of 0G Labs: Welcome to the Trillion-Dollar Agentic Economy
- 8:15 PM - Panel: How institutional capital finds DeFi: from first touch to allocation
- 8:35 PM onward - Networking and on-site interviews
- 10:00 PM - Doors close

### Your hosts

Turtle (https://x.com/turtledotxyz) is a liquidity distribution protocol connecting asset issuers to a verified network of 432,000+ on-chain LPs through a unified platform that handles deal sourcing, due diligence, incentive distribution, billing, and LP relationship management, all verifiable on chain.

Lunar Strategy (https://x.com/LunarStrategy), part of Turtle Group, is the crypto growth agency behind 400+ projects since 2019 - from token launches to ecosystem campaigns.

### About our partners

Bond (https://x.com/BondSuperApp_) is the first DeFi super app built for AI agents - trading, lending, and payments in one platform, launched on 0G.

0G Labs (https://x.com/0G_labs) is building the foundational Layer 1 for decentralized AI, with $325M raised and one of the fastest-growing ecosystems in crypto.

Credi (https://x.com/credilabs) brings private credit on-chain, tokenizing high-quality SME receivables to connect DeFi liquidity with real-world yield.

Set on a rooftop deck, with the covered lounge hosting the keynotes and panel. Your first stop before KBW opens.

Spots are limited and registrations are reviewed. Register below to secure yours.

Photos and video will be taken at this event. By registering and being approved, you agree that your image may appear in event coverage and future marketing.

### 🇰🇷 Turtle과 함께하는 Liquidity Evening

KBW의 시작을 함께할 특별한 저녁에 여러분을 초대합니다.

본 컨퍼런스 개막 전날 밤, 강남 중심부의 루프탑에서 실제로 유동성을 움직이는 사람들을 위한 특별한 저녁이 펼쳐집니다.

한국에서 LP들의 자금이 실제로 어디로 향하고 있는지에 대한 두 번의 짧은 키노트와 패널 세션이 진행되며, 이후에는 펀드, 패밀리 오피스, 빌더들과 자유롭게 이야기하고 네트워킹하는 시간을 갖습니다.

강남의 루프탑에서 드링크와 함께 서울의 야경을 즐기며 KBW를 시작해보세요.

날짜: 2026년 9월 29일(화)

시간: 오후 6:30 ~ 10:00

장소: L7 강남 플로팅 바, 서울 강남

언어: 영어, 한-영 이중언어 진행

주최: Turtle (https://x.com/turtledotxyz) & Lunar Strategy (https://x.com/LunarStrategy)

공동 주최: Bond (https://x.com/BondSuperApp_) & 0G Labs (https://x.com/0G_labs)

프리미엄 스폰서: Credi (https://x.com/credilabs)

### 연사

- Essi Lagevardi, (https://x.com/SuperChad15) Turtle CEO & Founder - 크립토 업계 최대 규모 중 하나인 유동성 조정 네트워크를 구축하고 있습니다.
- Taweh Beysolow II (https://x.com/TawehBeysolow), Bond CEO & Co-founder - 전 Jump Trading 및 Flowdesk 퀀트로, 현재 에이전틱 이코노미를 위한 최초의 DeFi 슈퍼앱을 구축하고 있습니다.
- Michael Heinrich (https://x.com/michaelh_0g), 0G Labs CEO & Co-founder - 3억 2,500만 달러 이상의 투자를 유치한 최대 규모의 AI L1 생태계를 이끌고 있습니다. Forbes 40 Under 40에 선정되었으며 Bridgewater와 Microsoft를 거쳤습니다.
- Alessio Marinelli (https://www.linkedin.com/in/marinellialessio/), Credi CEO - 프라이빗 크레딧과 중소기업(SME) 매출채권을 토큰화하며, 2017년부터 실물자산에서 발생하는 수익을 온체인으로 가져오고 있습니다.
- Tim Haldorsson (https://x.com/TimHaldorsson), Lunar Strategy Founder & Turtle CMO - 패널 모더레이터. 2017년부터 크립토 업계에서 활동하며 300개 이상의 프로젝트 성장을 지원했습니다.

### 이런 분들을 위한 자리입니다

아시아 시장에 자금을 운용하고 있는 LP, 패밀리 오피스 및 펀드, 그리고 유동성 인프라를 구축하고 있는 빌더와 프로토콜 관계자를 위한 자리입니다. 자본을 움직이거나 자본이 흐르는 곳을 만들어가고 있다면, 이번 저녁은 여러분을 위한 자리입니다.

### 행사 일정

- 오후 6:30 - 입장 및 웰컴 드링크
- 오후 7:00 - 케이터링 및 커스텀 칵테일
- 오후 7:30 - 오프닝 키노트: Turtle CEO Essi Lagevardi
- 오후 7:45 - 파트너 키노트: Bond CEO Taweh Beysolow II
- 오후 8:00 - 파트너 키노트: 0G Labs CEO Michael Heinrich
- 오후 8:15 - 패널: 한국의 LP와 유동성 분배
- 오후 8:35 이후 - 자유 네트워킹 및 현장 인터뷰 촬영
- 오후 10:00 - 행사 종료

### 주최사 소개

Turtle은 자산 발행사와 432,000명 이상의 검증된 온체인 LP 네트워크를 연결하는 유동성 분배 프로토콜입니다. 딜 소싱, 실사, 인센티브 분배, 빌링 및 LP 관계 관리까지 하나의 통합 플랫폼에서 지원하며, 모든 과정은 온체인에서 검증할 수 있습니다.

Turtle Group의 일원인 Lunar Strategy는 2019년부터 400개 이상의 프로젝트와 함께해 온 크립토 성장 에이전시로, 토큰 출시부터 생태계 캠페인까지 다양한 프로젝트의 성장을 지원해 왔습니다.

파트너 소개

Bond는 AI 에이전트를 위해 구축된 최초의 DeFi 슈퍼앱으로, 트레이딩, 렌딩, 결제를 하나의 플랫폼에서 제공하며 0G에서 출시되었습니다.

0G Labs는 탈중앙화 AI를 위한 기반 Layer 1을 구축하고 있으며, 3억 2,500만 달러의 투자를 유치하고 크립토 업계에서 가장 빠르게 성장하는 생태계 중 하나를 만들어가고 있습니다.

Credi는 우량 중소기업 매출채권을 토큰화하여 DeFi 유동성과 실물자산 수익을 연결하고, 프라이빗 크레딧을 온체인으로 가져오고 있습니다.

본 행사는 루프탑 데크에서 진행되며, 키노트와 패널 세션은 실내 라운지에서 진행됩니다.

KBW가 시작되기 전, 가장 먼저 함께할 자리입니다.

참석 인원은 제한되어 있으며, 모든 신청은 검토 후 승인됩니다. 아래에서 등록하여 자리를 신청해 주세요.

본 행사에서는 사진 및 영상 촬영이 진행됩니다. 행사 등록 후 참석 승인을 받으시면, 행사 관련 콘텐츠 및 향후 마케팅 자료에 본인의 모습이 포함될 수 있음에 동의하는 것으로 간주됩니다.

### 티오십사(T54)

T54 Labs is Building the Trust Layer for the Agentic Economy - The Risk and Underwriting Infrastructure that lets Institutions and Applications put AI Agents to Work with Confidence. Before money moves, T54 Verifies an Agent's Identity and Intent, Assesses Transaction and Counterparty Risk, and Preserves The Evidence needed for Compliance and Accountability. T54 is also Building Agentic Financial Infrastructure, bringing these same Safeguards directly into the Protocols and Financial Rails where Agents Transact - so Trust ㅠecomes part of the Infrastructure Itself.

ZEKTO is an AI and Blockchain Infrastructure Company making Stablecoins work in the Real Economy. ### How to get People The Terrace?

1. Using a Korean Map App

Search for "피플 더 테라스" in a Korean Map App.

2. By Taxi

Ask your driver to enter "피플 더 테라스" as the Destination in their Navigation system.

3. By Subway

Take Exit 2 at Apgujeong Rodeo Station (Suin-Bundang Line). Head Straight and Follow the Route marked on the Map for approximately 800m to reach the venue.

1. 使用韩国地图App

在韩国地图软件中搜索 "피플 더 테라스"。

2. 乘坐出租车

请司机在导航中将 "피플 더 테라스" 设置为目的地。

3. 乘坐地铁

乘坐 水仁-盆唐线，在 狎鸥亭罗德奥站 下车，从 2号出口 出站。出站后向前直行，沿地图标注的路线步行约 800米 即可到达。

Savior of Health (https://saviorofhealth.app/) is a blockchain-based AI health management platform that combines artificial intelligence and Web3 technologies to create a "Health to Earn" ecosystem. The project enables users to securely manage personal health records, receive AI-powered health guidance, and earn rewards for maintaining healthy habits. By leveraging decentralized medical data, privacy-focused infrastructure, and AI-assisted health journaling, it aims to transform everyday health activities into valuable digital assets while supporting scientific research and broader healthcare innovation.

It provides a transparent ecosystem where users can discover new opportunities, participate in project launches, and earn rewards while helping projects grow their communities. By combining social participation with on-chain activities, LuckyGo aims to make Web3 discovery more accessible and engaging for everyone.

MY AI PET (https://myaipet.ai/) is a blockchain-powered platform where users raise unique AI companions that grow, learn, and evolve through daily interactions. Combining AI-generated content, social engagement, and on-chain rewards, it introduces a "Raise-to-Earn" model that transforms emotional companionship into lasting digital value. The project blends AI, gaming, and Web3 to create an interactive ecosystem where every pet becomes a personalized companion and a meaningful on-chain asset.

Everwood Capital (https://x.com/EverwoodCapital) is a founder-led investment firm focused on high-conviction opportunities across Pre-IPO technology and crypto-native protocols. ### About the event

Korea Blockchain Week brings thousands to the city, but the most consequential conversations happen in smaller rooms. Native and BDACS are curating an intimate evening for 40 senior leaders driving the future of stablecoin-powered payments.

This is not a typical networking mixer, rather a private salon designed for founders, executives, and infrastructure builders focused on one question: how do we make cross-border settlement faster, cheaper, and more compliant?

At the center of the conversation is KRW1 - Korea's emerging institutional-grade stablecoin, and the global payment rails forming around it. We are bringing together the architects of stablecoin ecosystems and payment infrastructure with the companies deploying them at scale.

The Format:

Join us at a cozy cocktail bar in Seoul, for an evening of curated conversation and premium pours. The atmosphere is relaxed; the caliber of the room is not.

### Who Should Attend

- Payment Leaders: Founders and C-suite executives from cross-border payment and remittance companies.
- Infrastructure Builders: Heads of product and engineering from payment rails, settlement networks, and on/off-ramp providers.
- Stablecoin Issuers & Partners: Senior leaders from stablecoin projects and their ecosystem partners.

### Details

Date: September 29, 2026

Time: 7:00 PM - 10:00 PM

Location: A private cocktail bar in Seoul (revealed upon approval)

Apply to attend. Space is strictly limited.

### About the hosts

Native is a fintech infrastructure company focused on bridging traditional finance and digital assets, with a particular emphasis on compliant on/off-ramp solutions and real-world asset connectivity.

https://native.financial/

BDACS is a digital asset infrastructure company providing 'Prime Custody Solution' to institutional clients. In the first half of 2026, it surpassed 80 billion KRW in assets under custody, the largest total of any digital asset custodian in Korea. It issued KRW1, the world's first Korean won stablecoin, and partners with Woori Bank, Galaxy Digital, and Circle.

https://www.bdacs.co.kr/en

Asseto is a full-stack asset tokenization infrastructure and service provider, helping traditional financial assets access on-chain capital markets in a compliant, efficient, and scalable way.

https://asseto.finance/

### Seoul Digital Money Summit 2026 Q4 : Wiring Korea to the World

The Institutional Case for Cross-Border Digital Assets

Wiring Korea to the World is a premier gathering for institutional leaders, journalists, and industry professionals shaping the future of capital markets and global financial networks.

The way money and assets cross borders is undergoing a fundamental transformation. As Deposit Tokens and Real-World Asset (RWA) tokenization transition into core financial infrastructure, this program will examine the market infrastructure and operational requirements needed at scale.

Join us as we explore the seamless connection between global networks and Korea's domestic financial systems, and discuss the emerging opportunities and practical challenges for financial institutions worldwide.

### Event Details

- Date & Time: Wednesday, September 30, 2026 | 09:30 AM - 12:00 PM (KST)
- Location: Hashed Lounge (20F, K-Square Gangnam 2, Seoul)
- Hosted by: SOOHO.IO

### Program (Timetable)

- 09:00 - 10:00 |
  - Registration & Networking (Breakfast provided)
- 10:00 - 10:15 |
  - [KEYNOTE] A New Infrastructure Connecting Korean Finance to the Global Financial Network
    - Jisu Park | CEO, SOOHO.IO
- 10:20 - 11:00 |
  - [PANEL 1] The Future of Deposit Token-Based Financial Infrastructure
    - Theme: To Swift or Not to Swift
    - Panelists: Partior, KB Securities, NH Investment & Securities, and more
- 11:10 - 11:50 |
  - [PANEL 2] RWA Tokenization and the Structural Shift in Capital Markets
    - Theme: Rewiring the Capital Markets Stack (Tracking actual fund flows on-chain and exploring constraints and opportunities for domestic securities firms)
    - Panelists: Ondo Finance, Meritz Securities, Tiger Research, and more
- 12:00 | Closing
  (※ Detailed programs and speakers are subject to change based on on-site conditions.

### Featuring

Partior, KB Securities, NH Investment & Securities, Ondo Finance, Meritz Securities, Tiger Research and more

### Hosted by SOOHO.IO

(Website: https://www.sooho.io (https://www.sooho.io/))

Founded in 2019, SOOHO.IO is a financial infrastructure company that builds institutional-grade digital asset infrastructure based on its deep expertise in blockchain security. The company's core service, 'SOOHO PartnerHub,' is a distributed ledger-based global payment and settlement platform. It empowers institutions to seamlessly integrate cross-border remittances, foreign exchange (FX), and settlement functions while maintaining bank-grade security.

In addition, SOOHO.IO operates 'Purplace,' a Purpose Bound Money (PBM) platform, and 'Reagent,' a smart contract security management platform, establishing new standards for next-generation payment and settlement technologies.

### 솔라나 서밋, 한국에 상륙합니다 🇰🇷

> *English version is available below.

Solana Summit Korea는 한국의 스테이블코인, 규제 프레임워크, 그리고 자본시장의 미래를 그려나갈 기관 중심의 Invite-only 컨퍼런스입니다. 기관 리더, 정책 입안자, 규제 당국, 그리고 디지털 자산 분야를 개척하는 선구자들을 모십니다.

- 일시: 9월 30일 (수) 9:30 - 17:00
- 장소: 서울 여의도
  *상세 정보는 승인된 티켓 소지자에게 안내됩니다.

현재 정부가 스테이블코인 제도화를 적극적으로 추진함에 따라, 서울은 글로벌 정책과 기관 금융이 교차하는 독보적인 위치에 서게 되었습니다.

Korea Blockchain Week(KBW) 2026 기간 중 개최되는 본 서밋은 리테일 마케팅을 배제하고, 기관의 실질적 도입, 운영 준비, 그리고 규제 대응에 집중합니다. 스테이블코인 시대를 준비하는 전통 금융기관과 그 전환을 이끄는 글로벌 선구자들이 직접 연결되는 최고 수준의 장을 지향합니다.

공식 웹사이트 (https://summit.superteamkr.com)

### 기대할 수 있는 것

- 한국 금융 허브의 중심: 서울 여의도에서 열리는 기관 중심 컨퍼런스
- 실행 가능한 인사이트: 솔라나의 주요 전략적 글로벌 파트너들이 전하는 실질적 강연과 임원급 키노트
- 기관 PoC 쇼케이스: 솔라나 재단과 국내 주요 금융기관이 공동 구축한 개념검증(PoC)의 라이브 시연
- 최고 수준의 네트워킹: 메인 컨퍼런스 홀과 분리된 네트워킹 공간 및 프라이빗 오찬

### 참석 대상

- 기관: 디지털 자산 관련 실질적 과제를 추진 중인 상업은행, 자산운용사, 증권사, 핀테크의 임원급 리더
- 정책 입안자 및 규제 당국: 한국의 스테이블코인 및 디지털 자산 입법 프레임워크를 설계하는 관계자 및 자문위원
- 디지털 자산 선구자: 스테이블코인, RWA, 기관용 DeFi에 집중하는 솔라나 생태계 내 창업자 및 핵심 인프라 구축자
- 오피니언 리더: 엄선된 기관 리서치 애널리스트 및 최상위 금융-기술 분야 저널리스트

## Institutional Privacy Day @ KBW 2026 \| Co-Hosted by Citrea & Four Pillars

- Record: `kbw-official-institutional-privacy-day-09-30`

### About the event

As institutional capital moves deeper into digital assets, one question is becoming impossible to ignore: how do institutions bring real financial activity on-chain without giving up the privacy and confidentiality their business demands?

Institutional Privacy Day brings together privacy builders, funds, custodians, and policymakers on the sidelines of Korea Blockchain Week for a focused, closed-door conversation on privacy infrastructure for institutional capital.

Institutional Privacy Day is co-hosted by Citrea and Four Pillars.

Who should attend: Institutional investors, fund managers, custodians, exchanges, policymakers, and builders working at the intersection of Bitcoin, privacy, and institutional finance.

This is an invite-only gathering with limited capacity. Apply below - approved guests will receive confirmation and venue details ahead of the event.

### What to expect

- Deep-dive talks and panels on privacy tech for institutional DeFi
- Perspectives from funds, custodians, and regulators navigating on-chain privacy
- High-signal networking with the institutional side of the Bitcoin ecosystem

### About Citrea

Citrea is the Bitcoin application layer, enabling institutions and users to access Bitcoin capital markets. With zero-knowledge technology, Citrea expands Bitcoin's utility while remaining anchored to its security model. Access Bitcoin lending, yield and private BTC at app.citrea.xyz (https://app.citrea.xyz)

### About Four Pillars

Four Pillars is a blockchain research house founded in Seoul in 2023 and backed by Pantera, and Kakao Ventures. The firm has published over 500 research articles and partnered with more than 100 protocols and companies worldwide.

It also provides institutional digital asset research, operates validator infrastructure through FP Validated, and advises traditional financial institutions entering the digital asset market across Asia.

## Alpha in Seoul - Korean SMA Trading House Roundtable

### About the event

Korea's API-based SMA (separately managed account) trading houses, together in one room.

Hosted by Silentist, Hedron, Ascend, and Onyx Union - trading houses with proven multi-year track records

What Each House Will Share

- How it views the market & thesis
- Which inefficiencies it believes are worth trading
- How those ideas are implemented across exchanges, infrastructure, and client accounts
- What it learned from its most challenging periods
- Its track record, presented in its own words

Individual strategies will remain private. A separate fact sheet for each house will be provided.

Who This Is For

- Allocators, family offices, and funds of funds evaluating managed-account structures
- Brokers, prime services, and custody teams serving APAC allocators
- A limited number of invited infrastructure and advisory partners

As seating is limited, we are unable to accommodate attendees whose primary purpose is project BD, media coverage, or recruiting.

### Program

- 3:00 PM - Opening & co-host introductions
- 3:05 PM - House sessions: 10-15 minutes per house, 4 houses
- 4:00 PM - Panel Q&A: submitted questions followed by live questions from the floor
- 4:35 PM - Lounge sessions: meet each house to discuss mandates and operating structures directly
- 5:25 PM - Closing

### Please Note

- Invitation-based; all registrations are subject to approval.
- This event does not constitute a solicitation or offer of any investment product.
- Each house will present its approach and track record for informational purposes only.
- Photography and audio or video recording are not permitted.

Getting There

Dreaum Sky Hall (8F), Seonghong Tower, 138 Teheran-ro - 30 seconds from Yeoksam Station (Line 2). From Walkerhill (KBW main venue): shuttle to Gangbyeon Station, then Line 2 direct to Yeoksam (~30 minutes door to door).

### ***

한국에서 API 기반 SMA(Separately Managed Account)를 운용하는 트레이딩 하우스들이 한자리에 모입니다.

수년 간 시장에서 성과를 증명한 4개의 하우스 - 사일런티스트, 헤드론, 어센드, 오닉스 유니온이 주최합니다.

각 하우스가 공유하는 내용

- 시장을 바라보는 관점과 철학
- 어떤 시장의 비효율을 타겟하는지
- 거래소-인프라-고객 계좌 전반에 걸쳐 구현하는 방식
- 가장 어려웠던 운용 구간에서 얻은 교훈
- 각 팀의 언어로 설명하는 트랙레코드

개별 전략은 공개하지 않습니다. 각 하우스의 팩트시트는 별도로 제공됩니다.

이런 분들을 위한 자리입니다

- SMA 구조를 검토 중인 얼로케이터-패밀리오피스-FoF
- APAC 얼로케이터를 담당하는 브로커-프라임 서비스-커스터디 팀
- 소수의 초청 인프라-자문 파트너

좌석이 제한된 관계로 프로젝트 BD, 미디어 취재 또는 리크루팅을 주된 목적으로 하는 참석은 받기 어렵습니다.

프로그램

- 15:00 - 오프닝 및 공동 주최사 소개
- 15:05 - 하우스 세션: 4개 하우스, 각 10~15분
- 16:00 - 패널 Q&A: 사전 접수된 질문 및 현장 질의
- 16:35 - 라운지 세션: 각 하우스와 위임 구조 및 운용 방식 직접 논의
- 17:25 - 클로징

안내 사항

- 초청 기반 행사이며, 모든 참가 등록은 승인 절차를 거쳐 확정됩니다.
- 본 행사는 특정 투자상품에 대한 권유나 청약의 제안이 아닙니다.
- 각 팀의 운용 접근법과 트랙레코드는 정보 제공 목적으로만 소개됩니다.
- 행사 중 사진 촬영 및 녹음-녹화는 허용되지 않습니다.

오시는 길

역삼역 도보 30초, 테헤란로 138 성홍타워 8층 스카이홀. 워커힐(KBW 메인 베뉴)에서는 셔틀로 강변역 이동 후 2호선으로 역삼역까지 환승 없이 약 30분입니다.

## THE NEXT AI & Payment CARNIVAL
